gloss: series of works; planting the same crop repeatedly

definitions.explanation: A set of paintings, poems, photographs or other works made on one theme and meant to be seen together.

definitions.gloss: continuous cropping; growing the same crop year after year
definitions.explanation: Growing the same crop in the same field season after season, which tends to exhaust the soil and invite disease.

notes:
{連|れん} (in a row) + ⟦{作|さく}→作：27430_saku⟧ (work; crop). Sense 2 is common in gardening and farming.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連作|れんさく}⟦{障害|しょうがい}→障害：03228_shougai⟧: problems caused by continuous cropping (soil exhaustion, disease)
- {連作|れんさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧: to avoid planting the same crop
- {連作|れんさく}⟦{短歌|たんか}→短歌：15358_tanka⟧: a sequence of tanka on one theme
